architecture: SmallViT depth4 d32 heads4 mlp64 on sklearn digits
selection: Within each strategy select the validation-passing candidate with minimum replacement parameters; tie-break lower train-span holdout NMSE. Test is unavailable to candidate selection.
primary_hypothesis: The minimum passing composed replacement budget is lower than the minimum passing component-wise replacement budget under operationally hidden test evaluation.

primary_decision.coverage: all 16 seed files present; at least 12 eligible; every eligible seed has both passing endpoints

secondary_task_safeguard.statistic: selected composed minus selected component-wise test accuracy

stopping_rule: Run the fixed 16-seed cohort exactly once. Do not alter seeds, thresholds, grid, split, optimization, or decision rules after viewing outcomes. Any follow-up is a new experiment.
scope_boundary: One fixed sklearn-digits split and one SmallViT family. Model seeds are not independent datasets. A pass is not Transformer/LLM universality or grammar-independent complexity subadditivity.
